nature: Exploratory development experiment planned after the Stage 2B, 2C and 2D results were seen. CPU only. Not a confirmatory test, not an independent validation, not a final Test.

features.source: branches/inputs/<scene>.npz, array t<checkpoint>_policy_feature (saved once per snapshot before any continuation)
features.order: StandardScaler(policy_feature) -> PCA(8) -> StandardScaler(PC scores) -> append checkpoint one-hot [12, 52, 92, 132]
features.fit_on: unique training snapshots of the fold only, before repeats are expanded

weights: row weight 1 / (snapshots of its scene in the training fold * 4), then scaled to mean 1 over the training rows; the same rows and weights for every model

models.M_time: checkpoint one-hot only; two binary heads (Continue success, R5 success); score = q_R - q_C
models.M_Q: PC 8 + checkpoint one-hot; two binary heads; score = q_R - q_C (supervised success-value baseline, no Bellman backup)
models.M_pair: PC 8 + checkpoint one-hot; multinomial over joint_label = 2*y_continue + y_retreat5; score = p(01) - p(10)

decision_rule: R5 if score > 0, otherwise Continue. 0 is the expected-net-gain boundary, not a harm tolerance. No threshold, penalty or regularisation search.

evaluation.primary: leave-one-scene-out over the 36 scenes; results reported per stage, the 36-scene pool only as an auxiliary table
evaluation.snapshot_level: the arm chosen from the snapshot input is applied to all four repeats of that snapshot
evaluation.cached_episode: repeat 0 only; checkpoints read in order 12, 52, 92, 132; the first eligible checkpoint with score > 0 takes the stored R5 repeat-0 continuation; otherwise the stored trunk
evaluation.timers: Never, timer12, timer52, timer92, timer132; training-selected timer = the candidate with most successful training scenes, ties Never, 12, 52, 92, 132

not_done: Refresh / C1 / R2M / H0M as candidates or labels
